prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer:
Counting the major **modern .NET/.NET Core releases** and measuring from release date to official end-of-support date, **12 versions** have had support lifetimes longer than 12 months:

**.NET Core 1.0, 1.1, 2.0, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1; .NET 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, and 10.**

The only modern release with a support lifetime of 12 months or less was **.NET Core 3.0**—approximately six months. .NET Core 2.2 lasted slightly more than 12 months (December 4, 2018–December 23, 2019), so it is included.
